name: Asset Pipeline & Cooking
purpose: Implement asset loaders, hot reloading, compression, and texture baking.
inputs: Source asset inventory with formats, metadata, and ownership constraints
Target platform texture/audio formats, memory ceilings, and streaming budgets
Cooker version and settings, deterministic-build requirements, and benchmark scene
outputs: Content-addressed cooked manifest with reproducible hashes and budget report
Validated import, compression, hot-reload, and streaming implementation
Determinism, hot-swap, memory, and frame-time benchmark evidence
stop_conditions: Two clean cooks produce identical artifacts and every asset passes platform budgets
Hot reload and streaming complete without frame hitches or missing fallbacks
Token budget exhausted or the target cooker toolchain is unavailable
